messages.content:
You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE stadium (
    Stadium_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Location TEXT,
    Name TEXT,
    Capacity INT,
    Highest INT,
    Lowest INT,
    Average INT,
    UNIQUE (Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer (
    Singer_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Song_Name TEXT,
    Song_release_year TEXT,
    Age INT,
    Is_male bool,
    UNIQUE (Singer_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    concert_Name TEXT,
    Theme TEXT,
    Stadium_ID TEXT,
    Year TEXT,
    UNIQUE (concert_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Stadium_ID) REFERENCES stadium(Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer_in_concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Singer_ID TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    PRIMARY KEY (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    UNIQUE (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Singer_ID) REFERENCES singer(Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (concert_ID) REFERENCES concert(concert_ID)
);

If you want a “datasheet” (a table/listing) of all singers, you can query the `singer` table:

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Name;
```

If you meant a datasheet that also shows which concerts each singer performed in, tell me whether you want one row per singer (with aggregated concerts) or one row per singer-per-concert.
make sure the list is sorted by their age

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age ASC, Name;
```
the list should have the oldest singers first

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
make sure to add the countries of the singers too

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
the list should also include the names of the singers

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
the ages of the singers should also be included in the list

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Age
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
